summary: Short stretch on a narrow bridge approach over the creek; no room to stop.

drivers.seclusion: Tree cover, but homes 40 m or more away; irrelevant without room to stop.
drivers.access_and_room: 17 m of kerb on a narrow road meeting a bridge parapet, with dense vegetation and the creek beside it.
drivers.convention: No parked cars seen along it.

flags: Low-lying: 3 to 6 m elevation, creek 6 m away
Steep: about 18% on the DEM falling to the bridge
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over most of it.
